evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies peer address advertisement in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
rationale: Prevents nodes using proxies from self-advertising unreachable exit node IPs, eliminating significant network-wide addrman pollution. The description notes that previously 'up to three quarters of all Tor exit nodes appear in network address tables and trigger failed connection attempts,' making this a substantial improvement to connection management and address hygiene across network types.
